scope: Second-pass official-source review of top-level events 69-78 (10 events)

events.name: Eiger Ultra Trail by UTMB
events.gpx: Major update: 2027 event now includes the new E250 UNESCO Trail (official page currently lists 261 km/18,000 hm; the race name says 250 km, so use the measured published metric and flag naming discrepancy). The official E250 detail page exposes a GPX download. The 2027 event list confirms all other courses, but no binary GPX files were downloaded/parsed in this pass; earlier E101/E51 downloads pointed to 2026 files, so do not use those as 2027 replacements.
events.followUp: Download and parse the official 2027 E250 GPX; recheck each other course's download endpoint for a 2027-version file.

events.name: Bucovina Ultra Rocks by UTMB
events.gpx: Official 2027 race page now confirms all seven courses, including Rumble Rock (16.5 km/700 hm) and RUNC Challenge (5 km/550 hm). The previous checkpoint had Rumble Rock marked 'available soon' and RUNC unconfirmed; those course entries are now officially visible. GPX binary endpoints have not been downloaded or version-checked in this pass.
events.followUp: Export all seven 2027 GPX tracks from their race detail pages and validate each binary.

events.name: 3Kings 3Hills
events.gpx: Organizer's 2027 facts page (status 15 November 2026) confirms eight round-course offerings and explicitly states that 2027 distances/elevation differ from earlier editions. Organizer says GPX data are on individual route pages; direct binary downloads not extracted or validated in this pass. Older 2024 tracks must not be reused.
events.followUp: Extract eight route-page GPX files and compare parsed length/elevation against 2027 facts.

events.name: Davos X-Trails
events.gpx: Official 2027 Diamond page confirms 68.37 km/3,309 hm and provides a GPX download link. Earlier checkpoint's link pointed to a 2026 filename; recheck must verify the actual downloaded filename/content before treating it as current. Gold page values are not fully confirmed in this pass; avoid extrapolating hm.
events.followUp: Download the linked Diamond GPX and inspect file metadata/track; verify whether the file is actually 2027. Confirm Gold metrics and GPX separately.

events.name: The North Face Großglockner Ultra-Trail
events.gpx: Official 2027 event and five adult races confirmed, plus children's races. Note source discrepancy: the English registration page lists GWT as 35 km while German page and FAQ list 37 km; use German organizer value provisionally and flag. Official public direct GPX downloads not verified.
events.followUp: Resolve GWT 35 vs 37 km with organizer; obtain official app/athlete GPX files and validate all five adult routes.

events.name: SachsenTrail
events.eventDates: Organizer page shows 25-27 June 2027, but schedule content is mixed with 2026 references
events.gpx: Official page exposes a 2027 weekend date but its schedule and distances appear internally mixed: page introductory text mentions 36/22/16/12 km while the schedule lists Ultra 74, Half 36, Base 16, Quarter 20, Fun 12.6 and a 4.2 km prologue. A 2026 FunTrail GPX is visible; do not accept it as a 2027 track. Treat route data provisional until organizer clarifies the schedule/version.
events.followUp: Ask organizer to confirm 2027 course schedule and provide fresh GPX files; do not import 2026 FunTrail file as current.

events.name: Gauja Trail by UTMB
events.gpx: Official 2027 UTMB race pages now confirm all seven race formats and published course metrics. Map + GPX sections exist, but actual GPX binaries were not downloaded or parsed in this pass.
events.followUp: Export each official 2027 GPX and validate measured length/elevation.

events.name: Quito Trail by UTMB
events.gpx: Official 2027 event page confirms six races and metrics. The course detail pages still show 'Opening soon'; no official GPX download confirmed.
events.followUp: Recheck when race detail pages open and official Map + GPX downloads are published.

events.name: Pitz Alpine Glacier Trail
events.gpx: Official organizer confirms eight 2027 routes and their distance/elevation values. Registration info says GPX tracks are included, but direct 2027 binary URLs were not extracted or validated in this pass.
events.followUp: Download all eight 2027 GPX files through organizer route pages/participant package and validate each.

events.name: KAT100 by UTMB
events.gpx: Official 2027 event and metrics confirmed. Marathon Trail is a completely new single-loop course; organizer makes its map available for orientation but explicitly says the GPX file is not yet downloadable due to possible minor route adjustments. Do not substitute old two-loop GPX. Other 2027 route files were not binary-validated in this pass.
events.followUp: Wait for final Marathon Trail GPX; obtain and validate the remaining official 2027 course files individually.

importantUpdates: Eiger Ultra Trail 2027 adds the E250 UNESCO Trail; official detail page exposes a GPX download, while E101/E51 historical 2026 links must be rejected.
Bucovina 2027 now officially lists Rumble Rock and RUNC Challenge with metrics, closing earlier 'soon/unconfirmed' status.
3Kings 3Hills 2027 confirms eight revised courses; organizer explicitly warns that metrics differ from prior years.
Davos Diamond 2027 course page provides GPX link; actual file version still needs binary inspection.
Großglockner Ultra-Trail official English/German pages disagree on GWT length (35 vs 37 km).
SachsenTrail page mixes 2027 dates with inconsistent schedule text and a visible 2026 GPX; organizer clarification needed.
Gauja Trail confirms seven 2027 courses and metrics.
Quito Trail confirms six 2027 distances; detailed course/GPX pages remain unopened.
Pitz Alpine Glacier Trail confirms eight 2027 course metrics and GPX provision in registration info.
KAT100 Marathon Trail is a new 52 km/3,100 hm loop; GPX deliberately withheld until minor route changes are settled.
summary.gpxSafety: No GPX binary was downloaded and parsed in this pass. Links or Map + GPX widgets are not proof that a file is the correct current-year binary. Older tracks remain retained as historical and are not used to replace current GPX. No existing GPX files are deleted or replaced.
